senses.gloss: (b. h.) to shake, move; to be tender.

units: <cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 1:8">Tosef. Bets. I, 8</cite> <he>עד שיְנַעֲנֵעַ</he> unless he stirred the bird up (the day before, by which act he made it his property and designated it for slaughtering); Y. ib. I, 60ᶜ top. <he>אלא אם כן ני׳ מבעוד יום</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 3:1">Succ. III, 1</cite> <he>כדי לנַעֲנֵעַ בו</he> large enough to (hold it in his hand and) shake.

Ib. 9 והיכן היו מְנַעְנְעִים and at what passages of the Hallel did they shake (the Lulab)? Sabb. XX, 5 (141ᵃ) הקש … לא יְנַעְנְעוֹ וכ׳ (Bab. a. Y. ed. יְנַעְנְעֶנּוּ) must not stir up with his hand the straw &c.; a. fr.—נ׳ (ב)ראש to (shake) bow the head.
<cite ref="Berakhot 28b">Ber. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>כיון שנ׳ ראשו וכ׳</he> if he only bows his head (in prayer), it is sufficient.
<cite ref="Yevamot 121a:18">Yeb. 121ᵃ</cite> <he>וכל גל … נִעְנַעְתִּי לו ראשי</he> and as each wave came, I dipped my head under (to let it pass over me).
<cite ref="Yevamot 121a:19">Ib.</cite> <he>אם … יְנַעֲנֵעַ לו ראשו</he> if wicked people come over man, let him bow his head.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 37:1">Pesik. R. s. 37</cite> <he>ומנענעים בראשיהם</he> and shook their heads (in derision, ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 22:8">Ps. XXII, 8</cite>).—

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 953:7">Yalk. Prov. 953</cite> <he>ומנענע בו בקולו</he> and sings it with a tremulous voice; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 101a">Snh. 101ᵃ</cite> <he>מנענע בקולו</he> Ms. K. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 2); <cite ref="Tosefta Sanhedrin 12:10">Tosef. ib. XII, 10</cite> <he>מנ׳ קולו</he>.—Part. pass. <he>מְנוּעֲנָע</he>, pl. <he>מְנוּעֲנָעִין</he>.

Bets. 25ᵃ המקושרים והמ׳ the birds designated a day before the Holy Day by being tied or by being stirred up; ib. והמקושרין והמ׳ בכ״מ אסורין birds found anywhere tied or stirred up are forbidden to be taken up (because somebody has taken possession of them); Tosef. ib. I, 10 והמְנוּעָנִין (Var. והמנענין, corr. acc.).—2) to move in different directions, to introduce a surgical instrument.
